learning_outcomes.text: Acquire skills for analysis and synthesis of technical solutions in production processes and safety equipment application.
Assimilate the main terms, definitions and categories in risk and safety theory.
Assimilate the principles and methods of technical-production systems risk analysis.
Assimilate risk sources, characteristics, actions, normalizing, measurements and evaluation of Bulgarian and international standards of risk factors.
Assimilate the methods of creation of safety technical-production systems.

syllabus_topics: Ergonomic fundamentals of technical and manufacturing systems safety
Social and economical effectiveness of safety
assessment_rules: The final mark is formed considering the results of both written tests and successful participation in practice classes. Students are required to be prepared in advance on lecture themes, which is checked by questions.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
